text:
deploy-bot: starting staged rollout v2026.03.20-rc2 -> 15% traffic (global staged-rollforward). initiated by @ajay. change window 2026-03-20T18:00Z-20:00Z. channel: #eng-oncall

ajay: kicking this off, will watch SLOs closely. note: gpu-2a profile for this build has a new eviction path.

mara (oncall): seeing p95 jump in eu-west-1 on the SLO board, +320ms over baseline; 5xx rate climbed 0.9% in last 60s. attaching quick logs. :worried:

ajay: ack. pulling traces and pod logs. early signs show model eviction exceptions (trace id=0a1b2c).

observability-bot: live snapshot -> https://dash.redwood/boards/slo?svc=text-gen&region=eu-west-1&window=5m -- p95=1.2s, errors=0.9%. rule(s): slo.p95.warning triggered; annotated on release.

elaine (sre): propose region-scoped pin to previous stable (v2026.03.19) for eu-west-1 only. prefer partial pin over global rollback.

sindre (platform): we can route per-region. command:```
# pin eu-west-1 to prior version
deployctl traffic set --service text-gen --region eu-west-1 --version v2026.03.19 --percent 100
```

mara: running deployctl now, will post when change is live.

mara: applied - eu-west-1 traffic -> v2026.03.19 (100%). routing change propagated to edge within ~30s. enabling higher trace sampling for the region.

observability-bot: post-pin snapshot -> https://dash.redwood/boards/slo?svc=text-gen&region=eu-west-1&window=2m -- p95=420ms, errors=0.05%. improvement within 45s of pin. global p95 still reflects staged mix.

ajay: leaving global staged rollout at 15% for other regions. annotating release notes: "partial region pin: eu-west-1" and added follow-up task in the release ticket.

elaine: next steps: collect GPU eviction metrics, JVM heap, and node OOM patterns from gpu-2a ASG. upload to s3://rlw-debug/2026-03-20/eu-west-1/eviction-dump.log and link in INC ticket.

mara: created internal ticket INC-20260320-14. marking as sev-3 for now; will elevate if additional regions show regression.

ajay: plan: monitor for 30m. if stable -> ramp to 50% in safe increments. if we see repeat spikes, we'll trigger full rollback. leaving manual hold for global ramp. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: acknowledged. will post summary at 2026-03-20T18:30Z or on manual update.

sindre: temporary autoscaler bump applied to gpu-2a node group (+20% max pods) for the window to reduce eviction pressure.

elaine: add backlog ticket to try longer KV cache TTLs or eviction-resilient cache behavior for next rollout if this recurs. tag: perf; assign to eng-runtime.

mara: monitoring dashboards and alerts on watch. ping me for any new alert tags. :mag: 

ajay: thanks everyone. I'll update the release changelog and the canary notes with the pin and the follow-ups.
